title: Strict quotient augmentation and prescribed pro-etale reduction pullback
statement:
Fix the adic coefficient datum $A,I$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. On each scheme's small pro-etale site use the unbounded derived category of modules over the constant coefficient ring sheaf $\underline A$, the strict constant tower functor $\Delta$, quotient reduction tower $\mathcal R$, and its quotient augmentation $i:\Delta\to\mathcal R$ as in [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. For any morphism $p:U\to Y$, let $G_p$ be exact pullback of strict constant-coefficient towers, $p^*$ the ambient derived pullback, $s_p:G_p\Delta_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\Delta_Up^*$ the prescribed diagonal comparison, and $t_p:G_p\mathcal R_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal R_Up^*$ the prescribed normalized reduction/pullback comparison. Then
$$t_p\circ G_p(i_Y)=(i_U p^*)\circ s_p.$$
The equality is of natural transformations into the derived category of whole strict towers and includes every quotient transition. No completeness, properness, or perfectness of an input is required.

proof.text: On ordinary modules the quotient augmentation sends x to 1 tensor x. The normalized ordinary reduction/pullback comparison sends the pullback of 1 tensor x to 1 tensor the pullback of x, while the diagonal comparison is the termwise identity. Thus the ordinary strict tower square commutes. Quotient transition ring maps preserve 1, so these component equations are an equality of ordinary tower maps.

proof.text: Apply the cochain and homotopy functors to the ordinary tower square. Compute reduction on flat-term K-flat representatives with K-flat pullback. The universal reduction counits and the representative normalization of reductionPullIso identify the localized comparison edges with the specified reduction/pullback comparison; augmentation_normalized identifies the augmentation edges. The resolving-class localization property extends equality to the whole unbounded derived category.

lean.statement:
theorem supportReductionAugmentationPull {A : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) {U Y : Scheme.{t}} (p : U ⟶ Y) :
    whiskerRight (augmentation d Y) (exchangeConstantPull (A := A) p) ≫
        (reductionPullIso d p).hom =
      (diagonalPullIso (A := A) p).hom ≫
        whiskerLeft (pull (A := A) p) (augmentation d U)
